psychedelic: LSD, Psilocybin, Psilocin (plus 5-HT2AR analogs IHCH-7086, IHCH-7159, IHCH-8134, IHCH-8152; comparator ketamine)

handling.evidence: The Methods describe transfer to the experimental room for acclimatization but never describe a handling habituation protocol.

group_housing.evidence: Mice were housed in a credited specific pathogen-free facility, with controlled temperature (23 ± 1 °C), humidity (45-55%) and light — cage density not stated.

day_night_flipped.evidence: light (fixed 12 h/12 h light/dark cycle) — direction of cycle / phase of testing not specified.

enrichment_housing.evidence: Home-cage enrichment for mice is not addressed (enrichment with toys and snacks is described only for cynomolgus monkeys).

assays.assay_description: Mice suspended by the tail on a pressure sensor in a quiet room; 6-min recording, immobility time during the last 4 min analysed. Run in corticosterone- and CUMS-induced depression models, in wild-type, Htr2a-KO, Arrb1-KO and Arrb2-KO mice, with single-dose, single low-dose and repeated low-dose psychedelic regimens ± MDL100907, tested 30 min, 24 h and 7 days after administration.

application_type.evidence: Effects of LSD (0.015 mg kg -1 , i.p.), psilocin (2 mg kg -1 , i.p.) and IHCH-7086 (10 mg kg -1 , i.p.) ... measured with TST.

setup_habituation.evidence: TST methods describe only suspension on the pressure sensor in a quiet room; no pre-test apparatus exposure is mentioned.

setup_restrain.evidence: The tail of each mouse was suspended on a pressure sensor in a quiet room to avoid noise interference during recording.

food_restriction.evidence: Mouse is suspended by the tail on a pressure sensor; no food in the apparatus during the 6-min recording.

water_restriction.evidence: Mouse is suspended by the tail on a pressure sensor; no water in the apparatus during the 6-min recording.

time_to_assay.evidence: a significant reduction in immobility time tested 30 min after administration; ... after 24 h and 7 days administration

sample_size.evidence: The TST was conducted ... using eight mice per group (n = 8 per group)

outcomes.summary: Immobility (freezing) time in the TST was the depression-like readout. LSD (0.015 mg/kg) and psilocin (2 mg/kg) reduced immobility at 30 min and 7 days in corticosterone-treated mice, while IHCH-7086's effect was short-lived; IHCH-8134 (10 mg/kg) produced sustained reductions at 24 h and 7 days that were blocked by MDL100907 and absent in Htr2a-KO, Arrb1-KO and Arrb2-KO mice. Repeated low-dose LSD (0.00375 mg/kg ×20) reduced immobility comparably to a single 0.015 mg/kg dose with effects persisting ≥7 days, whereas repeated low-dose psilocybin (0.2 mg/kg ×10) alone did not.
outcomes.statistics: Ordinary one-way ANOVA (Dunnett's correction); NS, *P < 0.05, **P < 0.01, ***P < 0.001, ****P < 0.0001; n = 8 per group
outcomes.evidence: Mice receiving 0.00375 mg kg -1 LSD over 20 administrations exhibited reductions in TST immobility comparable to a single 0.015 mg kg -1 LSD dose, with effects persisting for at least 7 days (Fig. 5a). By contrast, repeated administration of 0.2 mg kg -1 psilocybin (10 doses) did not notably reduce immobility time in TST.

B1_num_measures.evidence: The immobility time during the last 4 min was recorded. This immobility time was used to measure depression-like behavior.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only the total immobility time during the last 4 min is reported; no within-session time-course analysis.

B4_ethological.evidence: Immobility in the tail suspension test is an artificial despair measure, equivalent to FST immobility (excluded by definition).

B5_social.evidence: Each mouse is suspended individually; no social construct.

B6_cognitive.evidence: No learning, memory or cognitive flexibility component.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: The tail of each mouse was suspended on a pressure sensor — a force transducer, not a behavioural classifier.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Ordinary one-way ANOVA on a single measure; no dimensionality reduction.

E1_environment_type.evidence: The tail of each mouse was suspended on a pressure sensor in a quiet room.

E2_shelter.evidence: definitionally absent in tail suspension apparatus

E3_bedding.evidence: definitionally absent — animal is suspended, no floor substrate

E6_spatial.evidence: Single suspension point on a pressure sensor; no compartments.

E7_social_context.evidence: The tail of each mouse was suspended on a pressure sensor in a quiet room (tested individually).

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in the suspension apparatus.

D1_continuity.evidence: freezing behavior ... after 30 min and 7 days of administration, measured with TST; ... after 24 h and 7 days administration

D2_session_duration.evidence: The recording lasted for 6 min, after which the mice were returned to their cages.

D3_recording_days.evidence: TST recorded at 30 min/24 h after administration and again 7 days after administration (≥2 distinct days).

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug TST session data reported.

D5_followup.evidence: producing sustained antidepressant-like effects observed at both 24 h and 7 days after treatment

assays.assay_description: Mice in a test cage with two bottles (1% sucrose vs plain water); bottles placed at 21:00 and weighed 12 h later at 09:00, sucrose preference calculated. Includes two-bottle acclimatization (≥24 h), a baseline sucrose session the day before, and test sessions after single, single-low or repeated low-dose LSD/psilocybin (and IHCH-8134) in corticosterone- and CUMS-induced depression models at 24 h and 7 days.

application_type.evidence: Effects of single-dose (0.015 mg kg -1 , i.p.), single low dose (0.00375 mg kg -1 , i.p.) and repeated low dose ... LSD treatment ... measured by SPT

setup_habituation.evidence: The mice were placed in the test cage and given two water bottles for acclimatization over at least 24 h.

setup_restrain.evidence: The mice were placed in the test cage and given two water bottles — freely moving.

food_restriction.evidence: The SPT methods describe only bottle placement and weighing; food access in the test cage is not stated.

water_restriction.evidence: mice were presented with 1 bottle of 1% sucrose water and 1 bottle of plain water.

time_to_assay.evidence: Effects of IHCH-8134 (10 mg/kg, i.p.) after 24 h and 7 days administration in CUMS induced depression-like model measured by TST and sucrose preference test (SPT).

sample_size.evidence: Eight mice (n = 8 per group) were used, consistent with the sample size in ref. 15.

outcomes.summary: Sucrose preference was used as an anhedonia index. IHCH-8134 produced a sustained reversion of anhedonia-like behaviour, and repeated low-dose LSD (0.00375 mg/kg ×20) increased sucrose preference in corticosterone- and CUMS-treated mice, whereas single low-dose LSD and repeated low-dose psilocybin alone did not; adding a therapeutic dose of LSD or psilocybin after repeated low-dose psilocybin restored the increase.
outcomes.statistics: Ordinary one-way ANOVA; *P < 0.05, **P < 0.01, ***P < 0.001, ****P < 0.0001; n = 8 per group
outcomes.evidence: These findings were corroborated by SPTs, which showed increased reward-seeking behavior following repeated low-dose LSD though not following repeated low-dose psilocybin (Fig. 5c,d).

B1_num_measures.evidence: The intake from both bottles was recorded, and the preference for sucrose water was calculated.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: bottles were placed in the cages at 21:00 and weighed 12 h later at 9:00 — a single cumulative measure.

B4_ethological.evidence: Only bottle intake/preference is quantified; no natural behavioural acts scored.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Hedonic consumption test; no learning or memory requirement reported.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Single preference measure analysed with one-way ANOVA.

E1_environment_type.evidence: The mice were placed in the test cage and given two water bottles for acclimatization over at least 24 h ... bottles were placed in the cages at 21:00 and weighed 12 h later.

E3_bedding.evidence: not reported — bedding in the test cage is not described.

E6_spatial.evidence: Single test cage with two bottles; no partitions described.

E7_social_context.evidence: Individual intake from two bottles per mouse is measured, implying single occupancy of the test cage.

E8_food_water.evidence: mice were presented with 1 bottle of 1% sucrose water and 1 bottle of plain water.

D1_continuity.evidence: The next day, the intake of two bottles containing 1% sucrose water was measured to establish a baseline. On the day of the experiment, mice were presented with 1 bottle of 1% sucrose water and 1 bottle of plain water.

D2_session_duration.evidence: For all baseline measurement and test sessions, bottles were placed in the cages at 21:00 and weighed 12 h later at 9:00 the following morning.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Baseline session the day before plus test session(s) on the day of the experiment (and at 24 h / 7 days in Extended Data Fig. 1f).

D4_baseline.evidence: the intake of two bottles containing 1% sucrose water was measured to establish a baseline

D5_followup.evidence: Effects of IHCH-8134 (10 mg/kg, i.p.) after 24 h and 7 days administration ... measured by TST and sucrose preference test (SPT).

D6_circadian.evidence: bottles were placed in the cages at 21:00 and weighed 12 h later at 9:00 the following morning

assays.assay_description: Automated magnetometer-based detection of head twitches in freely moving mice after LSD, psilocybin, IHCH-7159, IHCH-8134 or IHCH-8152, and after repeated low-dose LSD/psilocybin pretreatment followed by a hallucinogenic challenge dose; tested in wild-type, Htr2a-KO, Arrb1-KO and Arrb2-KO mice.

application_type.evidence: Mice were treated with saline or 0.015 mg kg -1 LSD (1 time (left), 3 times (middle) and 5 times (right) at 10-min intervals (a) or 0.00375 mg kg -1 LSD (20 times for 3-min intervals (b)) ... (i.p.)

setup_habituation.evidence: One hour before the experiment, mice were transferred to the experimental room for acclimatization — room acclimation only; no apparatus habituation described.

setup_restrain.evidence: Automated detection of HTR in mice by magnetic signal; animals move freely and no restraint is mentioned.

food_restriction.evidence: HTR is recorded in a magnetometer chamber; no food is placed in the apparatus.

water_restriction.evidence: HTR is recorded in a magnetometer chamber; no water is placed in the apparatus.

time_to_assay.evidence: The psychedelic LSD rapidly induced HTR in mice; a challenge dose of LSD was administered 10 min after the final low dose with HTR recorded immediately thereafter.

sample_size.evidence: For HTR detection, n = 4 per group was adopted based on our long-term validation showing consistent reproducibility and distinct group differences.

outcomes.summary: Number of head twitches was used as a proxy for hallucinogenic-like effects. LSD (0.15 mg/kg) robustly induced HTR, which was absent in Htr2a-KO but preserved in Arrb1-KO and Arrb2-KO mice; IHCH-8134, IHCH-7159 and IHCH-8152 produced no HTR and dose-dependently attenuated LSD-induced HTR. Repeated low-dose LSD (0.015 mg/kg ×1/×3/×5; 0.00375 mg/kg ×20) or psilocybin (0.2 mg/kg ×10) did not induce HTR and progressively suppressed HTR evoked by challenge doses.
outcomes.statistics: Ordinary one-way ANOVA; *P < 0.05, **P < 0.01, ****P < 0.0001; n = 4 per group
outcomes.evidence: No HTR induced by IHCH-8134, and LSD-induced HTR is reduced by IHCH-8134 in a dose-dependent manner (i.p.). ... Repeated low-dose administration did not itself induce HTR and progressively suppressed HTR induced by hallucinogenic doses as the number of low-dose administrations increased.

B1_num_measures.evidence: The numbers of HTR were recorded using the detection system.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only HTR counts per session are reported; no within-session binning described.

B4_ethological.evidence: Head-twitch response is explicitly excluded from ethological behaviours.

B5_social.evidence: No social component in HTR testing.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Unconditioned drug-evoked reflex; no learning component.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: HTR detection system based on magnetic signals — magnetometer event detection, not a video-based behavioural classifier.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Single count measure analysed by ANOVA.

E1_environment_type.evidence: Schematic of automated detection of HTR in mice by magnetic signal (magnetometer chamber).

E6_spatial.evidence: Single magnetometer chamber; no compartments described.

E7_social_context.evidence: Individual mice are placed in the magnetometer detection system.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in the HTR detection chamber.

D1_continuity.evidence: HTR was recorded in a single session after the drug/challenge administration protocol; no repeated HTR recording days reported.

D2_session_duration.evidence: not reported — the duration of the HTR recording session is not stated numerically.

D3_recording_days.evidence: HTR data were collected on a single day per animal/protocol.

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug HTR baseline recording reported; saline control groups were used instead.

D5_followup.evidence: HTR assessed acutely only; no ≥24 h post-dose HTR recording reported.

D6_circadian.evidence: Acute HTR session, far shorter than 6 h.

judge_notes: Only mouse assays were scored. Cynomolgus monkey assays (3D behavioural analysis, beam-walking, DMTS, food-tracking) were excluded because the rubric restricts scoring to rodents; no candidate included them.

All in vitro/structural work (BRET, calcium flux, radioligand binding, receptor occupancy, cryo-EM, crystallography, pharmacokinetics, 5-HT2AR Western/binding in brain) was excluded as non-behavioural.

Three mouse assays survive and are shared by all candidates: TST, SPT, HTR. All dose arms, genotypes (Htr2a-KO, Arrb1-KO, Arrb2-KO), stress models (corticosterone, CUMS), antagonist conditions and timepoints were collapsed into one entry per paradigm per the assay-identity rules.
B1: corrected gemma4's mapping error — a single behavioural measure scores 0, not 1 (TST immobility, SPT preference, HTR count each = 1 measure).

SPT E1: scored 'Home cage' (1), following the majority of candidates — mice are housed in the test cage with two bottles for ≥24 h and tested overnight there; E3 bedding left 0 because bedding is never explicitly described.
SPT D2: scored 3 (>6 h) per the explicit '21:00 ... weighed 12 h later at 9:00' statement; gemma4's '61 min–6 h' was an internal inconsistency.
SPT D5 set to Yes based on Extended Data Fig. 1f, where SPT was performed 24 h and 7 days after IHCH-8134 administration.
day_night_flipped set to not_reported (not 'no'): the paper states a 'fixed 12 h/12 h light/dark cycle' without specifying direction or testing phase, which the rubric defines as not_reported.
HTR setup_habituation set to not_reported: the stated 1-h transfer to the experimental room is room acclimation, which the rubric explicitly excludes from setup habituation.
